column1: # Pinned inputs of the similarity check. Tab-separated: slug, kind, licence, sha256, url.
# kind "jar" is a tool we run; kind "tar" is an upstream source archive we compare against.
# A checksum mismatch aborts the run. Hackage checksums come from the all-cabal-hashes
# metadata, the crates.io one (rustledger) was cross-checked there, and GitHub archives and
# the JPlag jar are pinned to the SHA-256 of their first download (2026-10-25).
